title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
findings: The proposed SEA (Spectral Editing of Activations) methods, especially the non-linear variants (Φ-SEA), were shown to be effective in mitigating bias related to religion. On the BBQ benchmark, the squared-exponential SEA method increased accuracy on the 'Religion' bias category from a baseline of 42% to 63%. On the CrowS-Pairs benchmark, Φ-SEA reduced the generation of stereotypical sentences in the 'Religion' category from 75.7% to 67.6%.
